changes.change: Replace the raw-installId manual rollback primitive with preview_rollback and a consuming rollback_package operation. RollbackPreview has private fields and no Clone/serde implementation. It binds current identity, epoch, retained verified candidate/data hash, revocation revision and a five-minute deadline. Commit rechecks bindings/policy/integrity and cancellation/deadline again after file reads, within the serialized Store transaction before mutation. Reuse the existing grant/session/context/task/exit cleanup owner.

Keep the named IPC and renderer port unchanged: installId requests a native preview, never directly authorizes rollback. The main caller must approve the exact preview in a native Ok/Cancel dialog. Cancellation returns without commit or executor shutdown. The helper requires native confirmation and rejects ended sessions; runtime policy is rechecked on commit. Stop executors/cancel network only after a successful commit. Mobile explicitly rejects manual rollback and receives no new permissions.

Add eight permanent native regressions using real SQLite and package files, including a controllable Clock. Adapt the two prior manual-rollback tests to consume native previews. Existing migration/recovery/revocation behavior remains covered.
